item.title: Gcochran patriotic war
item.description:
Source: TW

A friend at Los Alamos was running a gaggle of ex-soviet physicists in the 90s, who could be hired for an nickel then. got to know them: one talked about his father, an ace back in the Great Patriotic War. He was drawing little maps on the table cloth: " Dad dropped tularemia here, and here, and here…"
